AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE MONTH ENDING NOVEMBER 30, 2023.
Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file financial statements for the month ending November 30, 2023.
Staff Report
4.
APPROVE FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE CONTRACT FOR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES BETWEEN THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES AND MV CHENG & ASSOCIATES TO PROVIDE STAFFING FOR THE FINANCE DEPARTMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024.
Recommendation: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to sign the First Amendment to the Contract for Professional Services between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and MV Cheng & Associates in order to: (1) Extend the term of the agreement by two years to June 30, 2025; and (2) For Fiscal Year 2023-2024, increase the not-to-exceed amount from $70,000 to $97,000.

Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Forum Info Tech for Information Technology services.

Recommendation: That the City Council approve the Parklands Committee Action Minutes of the November 9, 2023 Meeting.
Staff Report
7.
APPROVE AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE AGREEMENT WITH BENNETT LANDSCAPING TO UPDATE THE NOTICE DEADLINE TO RENEW THE AGREEMENT AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTVE THE AMENDED AGREEMENT.
Recommendation: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement with Bennett Landscape revising the deadline for the contract renewal.

8.
REPORT ON THE FINANCE ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING OF DECEMBER 20, 2023 ON THE GENERAL FUND LONG RANGE FORECAST.
Recommendation: Receive and file a report on the Finance Advisory Committee meeting held on December 20, 2023, on the General Fund Long Range Forecast.
